From Wiktionary, the free dictionary
See also: Monnaie

French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Inherited from Old French moneie, monoie, from Latin monēta. Compare English money.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /mɔ.nɛ/
    • Audio:(file)
    • Audio (Paris):(file)
    • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

    Noun

    [edit]

    monnaie f (plural monnaies)

    1. change (money back after a transaction)
      10 francs de monnaie. ― 10 francs change.
      Gardez la monnaie. ― Keep the change.
    2. currency
      Le dollar est la monnaie d'Australie. ― The dollar is the currency of Australia.
    3. cash, change (coins, as opposed to notes)
    4. coinage

    Derived terms

    [edit]

    Verb

    [edit]

    monnaie

    1. inflection of monnayer:
